text: The factory resumes, by @gitdek's call on 2026-10-29: let's continue any open work on invariant and have it build itself. The pause of D-0131, from 2026-09-29, ends: its two watchers run again, rebuilt from main, on Codex on gpt-6-astra at ultra (D-0150, D-0151), and it takes issues as D-0105 has it. #177, whose /invariant plan was never drafted, and #91, which it superseded, were closed first, so the factory wouldn't draft either again.
